Audio Volume Booster

Boost quiet audio up to 300% volume and export as WAV, with clipping detection.

🔊 Drop an audio file here or click to browse
Above ~100% loud parts may clip — the tool counts clipped samples after boosting.

Clipping happens when boosting pushes samples past the maximum level — distortion. Lower the gain if the clip count is high. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Drag the gain slider from 100% to 300%.
  3. Click Download WAV to save the boosted audio.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the boost work?

Every sample is multiplied by your gain setting (100–300%). The tool counts how many samples clip and warns you.

Does it warn about distortion?

Yes — the result shows the peak level and the number of clipped samples so you can lower the gain if needed.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV.
